explanations:
`watch` 在此表「留意、当心」，比 look 更有警觉意味。常见错误：
• "Look your step" → 固定说法是 watch your step
• "Watching your step" → 祈使句用原形
`Watch your step` 既是「当心脚下」，也可引申为「小心行事」。同义：Mind the step.

items.sentence: I'll give you a call when I get home.
explanations:
**'ll = will**，表示将来。常见错误：
• "I **give** you a call" → 缺少将来时态标记
• "I **would** give" → would 是虚拟语气，这里不需要

**时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来**（主将从现原则）。常见错误：
• "when I **will** get" → when/if 引导的从句不用 will
• "when I **got** home" → 过去时与主句将来时矛盾
• **home** 在这里是副词，前面不加 to（get home = 到家）

sentenceAudio.text: I'll give you a call when I get home.

items.sentence: It was really nice talking to you.
explanations:
**It was nice talking to you.** 是道别时的客气话。句型：It is/was + adj + doing（真正主语后置）。常见错误：
• "It was nice **to talking**" → 只能二选一：to talk 或 talking
• "Nice talking **with** you" → 可以，但 to 更常见
见面时说 Nice to meet you；分别时说 It was nice talking to you. 更合适。

sentenceAudio.text: It was really nice talking to you.

items.sentence: Sorry, I have to go now.
explanations:
**have to** = 不得不（客观原因）。与 **must** 区别：must 侧重主观义务，have to 侧重客观需要。常见错误：
• "I have **go**" → have to 后接动词原形
• "I must to go" → must 后直接接原形，不加 to
道别常用三步：Sorry, I have to go now. → It was nice talking to you. → See you later!

sentenceAudio.text: Sorry, I have to go now.

explanations: **on my way** = 在（赶往）途中，回复「你到哪了？」时最常用。
扩展：**on the way to + 地点** 强调途中顺路：On the way to work, I grab a coffee. **on the way** 则强调「在途中」。

`See you later` 是口语道别，等于 See you soon / Catch you later。常见错误：
• "See **your** later" → 用 you 不是 your
• "See you **latter**" → latter（后者）拼写错误，应为 later（稍后）
`take care` = 保重、注意身体。分开说时可加逗号：See you later, take care.

`stay/keep in touch` = 保持联系，固定搭配。常见错误：
• "keep **the** touch" → 不加 the
• "keep touch **with** each other" → 可以说 keep in touch with sb，但单独用不加 with
道别收尾金句。答应别人可说 Sure / Definitely / I will! 更口语说法：Let's keep in touch!

items.sentence: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was terrible.
items.translation: 抱歉我迟到了，路上堵得厉害。
explanations:
迟到解释。`traffic` 不可数。常见错误：
• "the traffics" → traffic 不可数
• "I late" → 缺 be 动词，要说 I'm late
`was terrible` = 糟透了。同义：awful / a nightmare。

sentenceAudio.text: Sorry I'm late, the traffic was terrible.

items.sentence: I'll be there in about ten minutes.
explanations:
`in + 一段时间` = 多久之后（将来时）。常见错误：
• "after ten minutes" → 将来时用 in，after 多接时间点/过去
• "in ten minute" → 复数 minutes
`about` = 大约。同义 around / roughly。

sentenceAudio.text: I'll be there in about ten minutes.

grammar.pos: bring 的过去式 + 双宾语

explanations:
`bring` 的过去式是 brought（不规则）。常见错误：
• "I bringed" → 错，应作 brought
• "I bought" → bought 是「买」，读音接近但意思不同

`bring sb sth` 双宾语结构，等于 bring sth to sb（给你带了苹果）。常见错误：
• "bring you apple" → 可数名词泛指要复数

`way` 在口语里作程度副词，等于 much / far，表「远远地」。常见错误：
• "very too much" → 不能用 very 修饰 too
• "way to much" → 是 too 不是 to

`too much` 修饰不可数；可数名词复数用 too many。常见错误：
• "too many" 接 apples 才对

`partly` 表「部分地」，修饰形容词。常见错误：
• "part rotten" → 少了 -ly 就变成名词修饰
• "partly rottened" → rotten 已是形容词

`rotten` 是 rot 的过去分词作形容词，表「腐烂的」。常见错误：
• "rot" → 那是动词原形
• 水果「有点坏」也可说 It's going bad.

`bite off` 是短语动词，表「咬下来」。常见错误：
• "Bite that piece" → 少了 off，就没「咬掉」的意思
• "Bite off that piece" → 也通，但名词较长时更常放中间

祈使句用动词原形开头。常见错误：
• "Biting that piece off" → 祈使句不带动名词

`come to get you` = 过来接你，进行时表马上就到。常见错误：
• "I'm coming to pick up you" → 代词要夹中间：pick you up
• "I coming" → 漏 be 动词
相关：I'll pick you up at seven.（我七点来接你）
